verdicts.reason: Both have the same broken reading order: '$199' sits above 'New York', 'from' comes after the price, and the Meridian logo is shrunk to an illegible sliver jammed between 'New York' and 'from', so the brand is effectively lost. B is worse because its Book button runs into the right, top and bottom canvas edges and gets cut off, and its logo mark turns dark and low-contrast on the blue. A at least keeps some margin around the CTA.
